summary: @servicetitan/carto-rn-kit preinstall executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated payload via a downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a pinned Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh GitHub releases, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle heavily obfuscated with the obfuscator.io string-array + rotator pattern (`WV8StW(arr, n){ arr.push(arr.shift()) }`, `_0x…` identifiers, per-function string cover objects). `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated with `_0x…` identifiers and property-lookup cover objects concealing strings such as `--version`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, and `bun`. The package presents itself as a React Native component kit in the `@servicetitan` scope (README references `@servicetitan/carto-react-kit` and `@servicetitan/carto-tokens`), a purpose that has no need for a Bun runtime or an opaque math-init payload. The chain is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: attacker-shipped obfuscated code is executed by a freshly-fetched foreign runtime at `npm install` time, bypassing Node-oriented inspection. Installing this package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's host under Bun.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
